name: KG state decay (nightly auto-close)
notes: Auto-closes State/Event nodes whose TTL has elapsed (uses attributes.last_observed + attributes.ttl, GRACE_DAYS=3). Runs after proposal_promoter (02:30) so freshly-promoted nodes are in the candidate set, and before wiki_nightly_refresh (03:00) so closures flow into the wiki the same night. Nightly cadence so the graph doesn't accumulate ghost-open states between weekly maintenance runs.
